items.title: Subtitle Placement
items.summary: This change will improve the overall user experience by ensuring that critical information is more prominent and less likely to be missed, while still maintaining a low-friction interface that does not overwhelm the wearer in real-time interactions.
items.probe: Define one fixed subtitle position rule for V1: keep subtitles at the bottom center of the display.

choices.label: More Prominent
choices.description: Bias toward easier visibility over subtlety.

items.title: Confidence Display
items.summary: Implementing a clear and concise confidence display will help the wearer trust the subtitles more, reducing cognitive load and increasing their engagement with the product. This can lead to better overall usage and satisfaction.
items.probe: Choose one confidence display format for V1: label only or label plus short reason.

choices.label: Label Only
choices.description: Keep certainty display minimal and fast to parse.

choices.label: Label + Reason
choices.description: Expose a short reason to improve trust.

items.summary: This change will reduce battery usage by minimizing the amount of data stored on the phone and improve lookup performance by prioritizing recent interactions. It also ensures that memory reinforcement is focused on the most relevant entities, enhancing trust through stable behavior and fast retrieval.

items.title: Visual Hierarchy
items.summary: By prioritizing subtitles over one-line prompts visually, users can focus on critical information without being overwhelmed by too much text at once. This will enhance real-time subtitle clarity and low-friction assistance, making the glasses more useful in noisy environments and dense conversations.
items.probe: Define a visual priority rule between subtitles and one-line support where subtitles always appear above one-line prompts when space allows.

choices.label: Balanced Overlay
choices.description: Allow prompts to share attention more evenly.
